name: Gelidburn Oil
body:
Price 75 gp; Weight —

ABOUT

This greasy pale-blue liquid delivers a shocking sensation that is both freezing cold and searing hot. Gelidburn oil is popular among pickpockets looking to stab, snatch, and run.

DETAILS

Type poison, injury; Save Fortitude DC 12; Frequency 1/round for 4 rounds; Cure 1 save

EFFECTS

1d3 fire damage, 1d3 cold damage, and staggered 1 round
